name: harshit-mods
description: Harshit's Claude Code mods, plus the Claritymaxx explain skill.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context window forecast above the prompt: fill, 12-turn sparkline, turns left. /weather

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Catches rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push and more; shows what they would touch and forces a prompt. /blast-radius

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Records each turn's file edits; step through the diffs in a docked pane. /replay

plugins.name: changed-files
plugins.description: Live sidebar of every file touched this session with +/- counts. /changed-files

plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Status line with elapsed time, tool calls and files edited; toast when a long turn ends. /meter

plugins.name: claritymaxx
plugins.description: Turns difficult topics into clear mental models: text, a diagram or a small HTML page. /claritymaxx:explain

plugins.name: sync-home
plugins.description: Tells Claude to put anything you want on all devices into this repository. Triggers when you ask for something synced everywhere.

plugins.name: karpathy-guidelines
plugins.description: Karpathy's guidelines against common LLM coding mistakes. /karpathy-guidelines:clean-code

plugins.name: python-standards
plugins.description: Python standards: SOLID/DRY/KISS, FastAPI layout, naming, secure coding, linting. /python-standards:python-standards
